claim_scope: external validation on three drives of one operator
plan: internal plan, summarized in docs/TECHNICAL_REPORT.md, appendix

decisions.interval_rule: pooled calibrated coverage between 75 and 85 percent
decisions.point_rule: MAE skill against persistence positive in all three drives

calibrated_interval.assumption: exchangeable sessions; approximate for few calibration sessions
calibrated_interval.guarantee_in_this_archive: not established; report empirical coverage only
calibrated_interval.method: cross conformal CQR on inner session folds with equal session weights (Dunn, Wasserman and Ramdas, CDF pooling), globally and per predicted level quartile (Mondrian)
